title: api config (config.toml / .api.toml)
description: Configuration of the `api` CLI. It never holds secrets: tokens and passwords are value references (@keychain:NAME, @env:NAME, @prompt).

default_env.description: The [env.<name>] used when the shell has no session base URL.

vars.description: Which .env variables hold this project's URLs (URLs only, never a token).

base_url.description: Variable that holds the base URL.

graphql_url.description: Variable that holds the GraphQL URL.

env_suffix.description: The .env.<suffix> that `api env load` uses with no argument (a suffix, never a path).

defaults.description: Fallbacks for flags: flags > environment variables > these > built-in.

editor.description: Global config only. The command `api schema` opens items in (default $API_EDITOR, $VISUAL, $EDITOR, nvim).

token_cache.description: Global config only. Keep login tokens in the Keychain, bound to the env's base URL.

auto_login.description: Global config only. Log in again from the env's login block after a 401 (Keychain references only).

alias.description: Short commands: api <alias>. A project file may not use references or flags that widen where a token goes.

openapi.description: Path of this env's OpenAPI JSON document on its server (not a URL), for `api openapi sync`.

endpoint_prefix.description: Put in front of a bare endpoint name by `api schema` (v2/ makes user mean v2/user).

endpoints.description: GraphQL endpoints for completion and `api schema sync`.

token_env.description: Global config only. The variable that holds this env's token.

headers.description: Extra headers sent to this env (not credentials).

login.description: How to log in without typing: exactly one of path (REST) or gql (GraphQL).

path.description: REST: POST <path> with vars as the JSON body.

token_path.description: jq path of the token in the response.

vars.description: Body fields / GraphQL variables; dots nest. Secret-looking keys must be value references.
